Patrick Stewart Voice

A softer version of my Patrick Stewart voice

My voice on the promo for the European Collaboration Summit Mainz

I love the final edit of this video. They asked for a calm voice that was both strong and softly spoken. I experimented a little and found that my Patrick Stewart voice was a great fit. In the past, I’ve been asked for my Patrick Stewart voice for louder, more up-beat promos, so it was nice to use it for a slower, more contemplative video. The visuals and overall editing on this video is great and I’m very pleased to be part of it. If you’d like to hear more from my Patrick Stewart voice, check out my Siegecraft Commander and Minecraft explainer videos.

Patrick Stewart Voice

European Collaboration Summit in Mainz

The European Collaboration Summit Mainz is a huge conference event where people can network and attend talks about a variety of digital and business development subjects, such as Office 365, Azure, SharePoint, and Digital Transformation. The summit focuses on collaboration, on encouraging businesses to come together to create something bigger and better than they could on their own. This inspirational motive informed the production of this promo video and I love how it came together.

Get in touch

If you’re working on a TV ad or explainer video and you’re looking for a voice a little like this one I’ve used for the European Collaboration Summit, then please feel free to get in touch. Always happy to hear about a new job. To take things easier, I’m happy to provide a sample of your script so that you can figure out if my voice is a good fit for your brand.
